info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Jurisdictions To Triggers API
Return the data for all triggers

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter JurisdictionsToTrigger records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter JurisdictionsToTrigger records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: is_requirements_required
params.description: Filter JurisdictionsToTrigger records to those which require addition requirements to be checked (usually specifying trigger time).

params.name: is_served
params.description: Filter JurisdictionsToTrigger records to those which require a service type to be selected.

params.name: jurisdiction_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the Jurisdiction.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of JurisdictionsToTrigger records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 1000. Default: `1000`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the JurisdictionsToTrigger records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `description` matching a given string.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter JurisdictionsToTrigger records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
